title: Correct final volume V2
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must be expressed as V2 = (p0S + mg)/(p0S - mg) * V1 or an equivalent correct form.

title: Correct final temperature T3
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must be expressed as T3 = (p0 S V3 T1) / ((p0 S + mg) V1) or an equivalent correct form.

title: Force balance for piston
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply force equilibrium on the piston to find gas pressure in each configuration (a, b, c).

title: Apply ideal gas law
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the ideal gas law (pV/T = constant) to relate states (a) and (b) for part (1), and states (a) and (c) for part (2).

title: Identify constant mass process
description: Important: The solution must explicitly or implicitly state that the amount of gas (number of moles) is constant throughout all processes.

title: Correct pressure signs
description: Pitfall: Deduct points if the force balance for configuration (b) incorrectly adds the weight term, giving p2 = p0 + mg/S instead of p0 - mg/S.

title: Units and dimensions
description: Optional: The solution may include a check of dimensional consistency for the final expressions for V2 and T3.

title: Logical progression
description: Optional: The solution may present a clear, step-by-step derivation, labeling pressures and states before combining equations.
